purpose: Fail-closed persistence with canonical run-core identity and independently verifiable finalization for all five scheduled ChatGPT automations.
protocol_invariants: No immutable artifact may claim a persistence step that occurs after that artifact is created.
The substantive run result is represented exactly once as nested RUN_CORE and is content-addressed by RUN_CORE_SHA256.
History and latest wrappers may differ in persistence metadata, but their canonical RUN_CORE and RUN_CORE_SHA256 must match exactly.

A v3.1 run is fully persisted only when immutable history, current latest, and immutable finalization receipt mutually agree on RUN_ID, control-plane/automation identity, RUN_CORE_SHA256, and current blob SHAs.

canonical_run_core.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sort object keys lexicographically; compact separators; preserve array order; no insignificant whitespace.
include: lane-specific observations/findings/candidates/audits/conflicts/data gaps/provenance/test evidence and handoff payload

first_tool_sequence: update heartbeat.json to IN_PROGRESS using fresh content SHA
re-fetch heartbeat.json and verify exact RUN_ID/control_plane_id/automation_id
bootstrap.on_failure: Stop substantive work; attempt minimal Library failure receipt if a writable Library route exists; never claim RUN_PERSISTED.

single_flight.rule: Different RUN_ID heartbeat younger than 50m => DUPLICATE_SUPPRESSED. Age 50-75m => AMBIGUOUS_OVERLAP fail closed. Older than 75m => preserve as STRANDED_IN_PROGRESS then new run may start.

pass_8.action: Freeze canonical RUN_CORE and RUN_CORE_SHA256 only.

requirements: History contains RUN_CORE and RUN_CORE_SHA256 but does not claim latest promotion.
Re-fetch history and record returned history blob SHA before pass 10.

sequence: Write/replace latest.json with RUN_STATUS=RUN_PERSISTED, PASSES_COMPLETED=10, FINALIZATION_STATUS=LATEST_VERIFIED_PENDING_RECEIPT, the identical canonical RUN_CORE/RUN_CORE_SHA256, and verified history blob SHA.

Verify same RUN_ID, CONTROL_PLANE_ID, automation_id, lane/branch identity, exact RUN_CORE_SHA256 equality, recomputed canonical RUN_CORE hash equality, and latest.history_blob_sha equals actual immutable history blob SHA.

Create immutable finalization/<RUN_ID>.json with RUN_STATUS=FINALIZATION_VERIFIED, RUN_CORE_SHA256, history_blob_sha, latest_blob_sha, verification timestamp, control-plane/automation IDs, and returned commit SHAs when available.
Re-fetch finalization receipt and verify RUN_CORE_SHA256 plus both blob SHAs against current history/latest.
Only after receipt verification may heartbeat be updated to IDLE/FINALIZED.
pass_10.acceptance_rule: Fully persisted iff latest=RUN_PERSISTED, history exists, finalization receipt exists, and all three agree on identities and RUN_CORE_SHA256 while receipt binds current history/latest blob SHAs.

omega_acceptance.current: Require valid v3.1 finalization receipt binding current history/latest blob SHAs and RUN_CORE_SHA256.
omega_acceptance.legacy: Pre-v3.1 runs may be accepted only under explicitly classified migration rules when latest/history are directly verified and non-contradictory. Any self-claim conflicting with live repo state is QUARANTINED.

fallback.write_route_verification: Disposable canary successfully uploaded/read back at omega/state and then deleted.
fallback.on_github_failure: Attempt minimal Library failure receipt containing lane, RUN_ID, timestamp, error, control_plane_id, automation_id; then stop.
fallback.on_library_failure: Emit explicit persistence failure and stop; do not claim RUN_PERSISTED.

watchdog.rule: OMEGA checks latest/history/finalization/heartbeat for all lanes and, when automation registry access exists, compares trigger times to durable repo evidence.

scheduler_truth: automation last_run_time is trigger evidence only, never persistence evidence
